_comment: Phase 8. What the on-screen controls say. The strip itself is generated from CFG.keys, so adding a key puts a button on screen whether or not it is named here; a key with no row falls back to its own action name. The look-for chips take their words from observation.json's lookFors instead, because those already exist and there must not be two places that name the same rubric line.
hint: Left thumb walks. Drag anywhere else to look.
